summary: Dynex Capital disclosed on Form 8-K an Item 8.01 Other Events that its Board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $300 million of common stock and up to $50 million of preferred stock, replacing a prior program expiring April 30, 2026. The program is authorized through April 30, 2028, with no specific price or premium terms stated; repurchases may be made via open market, privately negotiated transactions, or 10b5-1 plans. The Board may modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time without obligation to purchase any shares. This is a pure capital return event, with no acquisition, tender offer, or activist filing involved. Watch for execution pace and market conditions as key variables; risk-arb angle is minimal, but the authorization signals confidence in undervaluation and shareholder return commitment.
